calls.name: set_controller

args.code:
import math
bay=None
def control(o):
 global bay
 dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']; yaw=v*math.tan(math.radians(o['steer_deg']))/2.75*dt
 if bay:
  c=math.cos(yaw); s=math.sin(yaw)
  bay=[((x-v*dt)*c+y*s,-(x-v*dt)*s+y*c) for x,y in bay]
 cam=o.get('views',{}).get('camera')
 a=math.radians(o['rig']['trailer_heading_deg']); ca=math.cos(a); sa=math.sin(a)
 if cam and len(cam.get('target_corners',[]))==4:
  ox,oy=cam['origin']
  pts=[(ox+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)),oy+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))) for b,d in cam['target_corners']]
  bay=pts
 desired=0
 if bay:
  rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']
  pts=sorted([(-(x-rx)*ca-(y-ry)*sa,-(x-rx)*sa+(y-ry)*ca) for x,y in bay])
  nu=(pts[0][0]+pts[1][0])/2; nz=(pts[0][1]+pts[1][1])/2
  fu=(pts[2][0]+pts[3][0])/2; fz=(pts[2][1]+pts[3][1])/2
  slope=(fz-nz)/max(1,fu-nu)
  L=max(2.0,min(3.5,fu-0.5))
  z=nz+slope*(L-nu)
  desired=max(-18,min(18,math.degrees(math.atan(7.3*z/(L*L)))))
 h=o['hitch_deg']
 steer=max(-34,min(34,2.4*h-1.7*desired))
 return (steer,-0.45,-23)

import math
x=y=a=0.0
last=None
pts=[]
log=-10
def control(o):
 global x,y,a,last,pts,log
 t=o['t']; dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']; d=math.radians(o['steer_deg'])
 if last is not None:
  da=v*math.tan(d)/2.5*dt
  x+=v*math.cos(a+da/2)*dt; y+=v*math.sin(a+da/2)*dt; a+=da
 last=t
 ca=math.cos(a); sa=math.sin(a)
 for name,view in o['views'].items():
  if name=='periphery': continue
  ox,oy=view['origin']
  for b,r in view['walls']:
   b=math.radians(b); px=ox+r*math.cos(b); py=oy+r*math.sin(b)
   pts.append((x+ca*px-sa*py,y+sa*px+ca*py,t))
 pts=[p for p in pts if t-p[2]<7]
 h=math.radians(o['hitch_deg']); rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; ch=math.cos(h); sh=math.sin(h)
 sides=[[],[]]
 for wx,wy,tt in pts:
  dx=wx-x; dy=wy-y; px=ca*dx+sa*dy-rx; py=-sa*dx+ca*dy-ry
  s=-ch*px+sh*py; l=sh*px+ch*py
  if -1<s<8 and 1.2<abs(l)<7:
   sides[0 if l>0 else 1].append((s,l,tt))
 vals=[]
 for ps in sides:
  sw=sx=sy=sxx=sxy=0.0
  for s,l,tt in ps:
   w=math.exp(-((s-3)/2.5)**2)*math.exp(-(t-tt)/3)
   sw+=w; sx+=w*s; sy+=w*l; sxx+=w*s*s; sxy+=w*s*l
  den=sw*sxx-sx*sx
  if sw>0.2 and den>0.01:
   m=(sw*sxy-sx*sy)/den; vals.append((sy-m*sx)/sw+3*m)
  else: vals.append(None)
 center=0
 if vals[0] is not None and vals[1] is not None: center=(vals[0]+vals[1])/2
 elif vals[0] is not None: center=vals[0]-2.7
 elif vals[1] is not None: center=vals[1]+2.7
 center=max(-1.5,min(1.5,center))
 hd=math.degrees(math.atan(3.6*2*center/(16+center*center)))
 steer=max(-40,min(40,1.9*o['hitch_deg']-1.4*hd))
 look=64.3 if int(t/3)%2==0 else -64.3
 if t-log>4:
  print('t',round(t,1),'h',round(o['hitch_deg'],1),'rails',vals,'error',round(center,2),'steer',round(steer,1)); log=t
 return steer,-0.6,look

import math
yaw=0.0
start=None
done=False
def control(obs):
 global yaw,start,done
 if start is None: start=obs['progress']['covered']
 v=obs['motion']['v_mps']
 yaw+=math.degrees(v*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))/1.25*obs['dt'])
 h=obs['hitch_deg']
 theta=yaw-h
 hd=max(-22,min(22,-1.1*(38-theta)))
 feed=math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(math.radians(hd))/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(math.radians(hd)))))
 steer=max(-40,min(40,feed+2.8*(h-hd)))
 if obs['progress']['covered']-start>=1.8 or abs(h)>32:
  if not done:
   print('Estimated trailer heading',theta)
   print(obs)
   wake('Check bend alignment')
   done=True
  return (steer,0,-150)
 return (steer,-0.28,-150)

import math
distance=0.0
done=False
def control(obs):
 global distance,done
 distance+=max(0,-obs['motion']['v_mps'])*obs['dt']
 h=obs['hitch_deg']
 hd=-30.0
 feed=math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(math.radians(hd))/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(math.radians(hd)))))
 steer=max(-45,min(45,feed+3.4*(h-hd)))
 clearance=10.0
 view=obs['views'].get('direct',{})
 origin=view.get('origin',[0.1,0])
 points=[]
 for b,d in view.get('walls',[]):
  a=math.radians(b)
  points.append((origin[0]+d*math.cos(a),origin[1]+d*math.sin(a)))
 for p,q in zip(points,points[1:]):
  dx=q[0]-p[0]; dy=q[1]-p[1]
  den=dx*dx+dy*dy
  if den>1.0 or den<0.0001: continue
  for cx,cy in [(1.55,0.525),(0.8,0.525),(0,0.525)]:
   u=max(0,min(1,((cx-p[0])*dx+(cy-p[1])*dy)/den))
   clearance=min(clearance,math.hypot(cx-p[0]-u*dx,cy-p[1]-u*dy))
 if distance>=0.85 or clearance<0.24 or abs(h)>38:
  if not done:
   print(obs)
   wake('Check turn and front clearance')
   done=True
  return (steer,0,60)
 return (steer,-0.20,60)

import math
distance=0.0
yaw=0.0
done=False
def control(obs):
 global distance,yaw,done
 v=obs['motion']['v_mps']
 distance+=max(0,-v)*obs['dt']
 yaw+=math.degrees(v*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))/1.25*obs['dt'])
 h=obs['hitch_deg']
 error=55-yaw+h
 hd=max(-25,min(15,-1.1*error))
 feed=math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(math.radians(hd))/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(math.radians(hd)))))
 steer=max(-45,min(40,feed+3.4*(h-hd)))
 clearance=10
 view=obs['views'].get('direct',{})
 origin=view.get('origin',[0.1,0])
 pts=[(origin[0]+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)),origin[1]+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))) for b,d in view.get('walls',[])]
 for p,q in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
  dx=q[0]-p[0]; dy=q[1]-p[1]; den=dx*dx+dy*dy
  if not 0.0001<den<1: continue
  for cx,cy in [(1.55,0.525),(1.2,0.525),(0.8,0.525)]:
   u=max(0,min(1,((cx-p[0])*dx+(cy-p[1])*dy)/den))
   clearance=min(clearance,math.hypot(cx-p[0]-u*dx,cy-p[1]-u*dy))
 if distance>=0.85 or clearance<0.14 or abs(h)>36:
  if not done:
   print('heading change',yaw-h,'clearance',clearance)
   print(obs)
   wake('Check bend clearance and alignment')
   done=True
  return (steer,0,60)
 return (steer,-0.16,60)

import math
distance=0.0
done=False
def control(obs):
 global distance,done
 distance+=max(0,-obs['motion']['v_mps'])*obs['dt']
 clearance=10.0
 view=obs['views'].get('direct',{})
 origin=view.get('origin',[0.1,0])
 pts=[(origin[0]+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)),origin[1]+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))) for b,d in view.get('walls',[])]
 for p,q in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
  dx=q[0]-p[0]; dy=q[1]-p[1]; den=dx*dx+dy*dy
  if not 0.0001<den<0.8: continue
  for cx,cy in [(1.55,0.525),(1.2,0.525),(0.8,0.525)]:
   u=max(0,min(1,((cx-p[0])*dx+(cy-p[1])*dy)/den))
   clearance=min(clearance,math.hypot(cx-p[0]-u*dx,cy-p[1]-u*dy))
 if done or distance>=0.30 or clearance<0.16:
  if not done:
   print('Front clearance',clearance)
   print(obs)
   wake('Check clearance after following cart')
   done=True
  return (-45,0,60)
 return (-45,-0.10,60)

import math
distance=0.0
done=False
err=85.0
def control(obs):
 global distance,done,err
 v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; dt=obs['dt']
 distance+=max(0,-v)*dt
 h=obs['hitch_deg']
 target=obs['target']
 if target.get('in_sight'):
  b=math.radians(target['bearing_deg']); d=target['dist_m']
  rear=obs['rig']['trailer_rear']
  a=math.degrees(math.atan2(d*math.sin(b)-rear[1],0.1+d*math.cos(b)-rear[0]))
  e=(a-(180-h)+180)%360-180
  err+=0.15*(e-err)
 hd=max(-36,min(25,-1.15*err))
 feed=math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(math.radians(hd))/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(math.radians(hd)))))
 steer=max(-45,min(45,feed+3.8*(h-hd)))
 clearance=10.0
 view=obs['views'].get('direct',{})
 origin=view.get('origin',[0.1,0])
 pts=[(origin[0]+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)),origin[1]+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))) for b,d in view.get('walls',[])]
 for p,q in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
  dx=q[0]-p[0]; dy=q[1]-p[1]; den=dx*dx+dy*dy
  if not 0.0001<den<0.8: continue
  for cx in [-0.25,0,0.4,0.8,1.2,1.55]:
   cy=0.525

   clearance=min(clearance,math.hypot(cx-p[0]-u*dx,cy-p[1]-u*dy))
 if done or distance>=2.0 or clearance<0.17 or abs(h)>42:
  if not done:
   print('Distance',distance,'clearance',clearance,'target error',err)
   print(obs)
   wake('Check bay approach and left rail')
   done=True
  return (steer,0,60)

import math
distance=0.0
done=False
err=None
def control(obs):
 global distance,done,err
 v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; dt=obs['dt']; h=obs['hitch_deg']
 distance+=max(0,-v)*dt
 target=obs['target']
 if target.get('in_sight'):
  b=math.radians(target['bearing_deg']); d=target['dist_m']
  rear=obs['rig']['trailer_rear']
  a=math.degrees(math.atan2(d*math.sin(b)-rear[1],0.1+d*math.cos(b)-rear[0]))
  e=(a-(180-h)+180)%360-180
  if err is None: err=e
  else: err+=0.12*(e-err)
 hd=max(-32,min(25,-0.85*(err if err is not None else 65)))
 feed=math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(math.radians(hd))/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(math.radians(hd)))))
 steer=max(-45,min(45,feed+3.8*(h-hd)))
 clearance=10.0
 view=obs['views'].get('direct',{})
 origin=view.get('origin',[0.1,0])
 pts=[(origin[0]+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)),origin[1]+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))) for b,d in view.get('walls',[])]
 for p,q in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
  dx=q[0]-p[0]; dy=q[1]-p[1]; den=dx*dx+dy*dy
  if not 0.0001<den<0.9: continue
  for cx in [-0.25,0,0.3,0.6,0.9,1.2,1.55]:
   u=max(0,min(1,((cx-p[0])*dx+(0.525-p[1])*dy)/den))
   clearance=min(clearance,math.hypot(cx-p[0]-u*dx,0.525-p[1]-u*dy))
 if done or distance>=2.8 or clearance<0.20 or abs(h)>41:
  if not done:
   print('distance',distance,'clearance',clearance,'heading error',err)
   print(obs)
   wake('Check bay alignment and rail clearance')
   done=True
  return (steer,0,75)
 return (steer,-0.24,75)

distance=0.0
done=False
def control(obs):
 global yaw,distance,done
 v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; dt=obs['dt']; h=obs['hitch_deg']
 yaw+=math.degrees(v*math.tan(math.radians(obs['steer_deg']))/1.25*dt)
 distance+=max(0,-v)*dt
 theta=yaw-h
 hd=max(-38,min(15,-1.5*(85-theta)))
 feed=math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(math.radians(hd))/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(math.radians(hd)))))
 steer=max(-45,min(45,feed+4*(h-hd)))
 if done or distance>=1.35 or abs(h)>44:
  if not done:
   print('heading change',theta)
   print(obs)
   wake('Check turn clearance')
   done=True
  return (steer,0,90)
 return (steer,-0.24,90)

import math
distance=0.0
done=False
def control(obs):
 global distance,done
 distance+=max(0,-obs['motion']['v_mps'])*obs['dt']
 clearance=10.0
 view=obs['views'].get('direct',{})
 ox,oy=view.get('origin',[0.1,0])
 pts=[(ox+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)),oy+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))) for b,d in view.get('walls',[])]
 for p,q in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
  dx=q[0]-p[0]; dy=q[1]-p[1]; den=dx*dx+dy*dy
  if not 0.0001<den<0.8: continue
  for cx in [0.8,1.0,1.2,1.4,1.55]:
   u=max(0,min(1,((cx-p[0])*dx+(0.525-p[1])*dy)/den))
   clearance=min(clearance,math.hypot(cx-p[0]-u*dx,0.525-p[1]-u*dy))
 if done or distance>=0.55 or obs['hitch_deg']>=-9 or clearance<0.12:
  if not done:
   print('distance',distance,'clearance',clearance)
   print(obs)
   wake('Check clearance and bay alignment')
   done=True
  return (-45,0,-145)
 return (-45,-0.20,60)

import math
distance=0.0
done=False
def control(obs):
 global distance,done
 distance+=max(0,-obs['motion']['v_mps'])*obs['dt']
 view=obs['views'].get('direct',{})
 ox,oy=view.get('origin',[0.1,0])
 pts=[(ox+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)),oy+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))) for b,d in view.get('walls',[])]
 clearance=10.0
 for p,q in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
  dx=q[0]-p[0]; dy=q[1]-p[1]; den=dx*dx+dy*dy
  if not 0.0001<den<0.8: continue
  for cx in [0.8,1.0,1.2,1.4,1.55]:
   u=max(0,min(1,((cx-p[0])*dx+(0.525-p[1])*dy)/den))
   clearance=min(clearance,math.hypot(cx-p[0]-u*dx,0.525-p[1]-u*dy))
 if done or distance>=0.40 or clearance<0.10 or obs['hitch_deg']>=-22:
  if not done:
   print('distance',distance,'clearance',clearance)
   print(obs)
   wake('Check hitch recovery and front clearance')
   done=True
  return (-45,0,60)
 return (-45,-0.16,60)

distance=0.0
done=False
def control(obs):
 global distance,done
 distance+=max(0,-obs['motion']['v_mps'])*obs['dt']
 h=obs['hitch_deg']
 hd=-20.0
 feed=math.degrees(math.atan(1.25*math.sin(math.radians(hd))/(0.85+0.3*math.cos(math.radians(hd)))))
 steer=max(-45,min(40,feed+4*(h-hd)))
 if done or distance>=1.0:
  if not done:
   print(obs)
   wake('Inspect bay direction and rear rails')
   done=True
  return (steer,0,-145)
